players.product: high-layer-count and high-order HDI PCBs for AI servers / GPU boards, plus mSAP 800G / 1.6T optical-module PCBs

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Liu Shaobai and the company (H1 2026 results briefing): the communications and data-infrastructure business was about 20% of H1 2026 revenue; as the share of AI-server products rises and utilisation of high-end lines climbs, the company says overall gross margin will keep rising in H2 2026. The chairman said that in H2 automotive electronics keeps recovering, the product mix improves and AI-compute customer orders keep ramping, lifting profitability; the gross margins of its AI-server PCBs, high-speed switch PCBs and 800G/1.6T optical-module PCBs are above the company's overall gross margin (not disclosed separately). Exchange movements hit H1 net profit by more than RMB 1.5 hundred million (an exchange loss of RMB 1.23 hundred million versus a gain of RMB 0.38 hundred million a year earlier). Since H2 2025 it has negotiated price increases with customers and prices new business for higher material costs, with the size of increases varying by material, process and product cost structure.
quarterly_data.figure: communications and data-infrastructure business about 20% of H1 2026 revenue; FX impact on net profit more than RMB 1.5 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Liu Shaobai and the company (H1 2026 results briefing): based on industry technology trends, demand growth and customers' product delivery plans, Kinwong plans to build an ultra-high-layer PCB smart-manufacturing project for AI-compute infrastructure that will mainly make ultra-high-layer PCBs in N+N, N+M and M+N+M structures, with capacity planned to match market demand; construction is being pushed to start production as early as possible. The Zhuhai Jinwan base, central to raising the high-end product share and to its AI growth curve, mainly makes HLC, HDI and SLP products. Director and president Liu Yu said high-speed optical-module PCB orders are mainly 800G, while 1.6T optical-module PCB orders are growing fast.
